scientific.integrity: The primary article was materially inspected in full-text form through its extreme-area theorem, proof discussion, octagon theorem, and remarks. A later related full-text paper and targeted published-literature searches were compared against the claim. The proof is exact over the quadratic field generated by square root of two; the bundled checker replays the finite facet enumeration.
limitations: The result treats the regular octagon only and does not classify regular polygons of all even orders.
It evaluates the area spectrum of inscribed affine-regular hexagons, not the broader packing and Minkowski-distance consequences of the source paper.
The chamber calculation is elementary once the three feasible cases are isolated, so an unindexed equivalent computation remains a historical originality risk.

title: Exact area spectrum of affine-regular hexagons in the regular octagon
